children.summary: The User Manual for the Qursor Tablet Application provides administrative details, specifically noting the issue date of January 5, 2026.

children.title: USER INTERFACE
children.summary: This section provides a comprehensive overview of the tablet application's user interface, covering the login process, main navigation bar, and specific operational views. It details the functionality of key menus including Kanbans management, Simple View monitoring, station selection, manual AGV control, and the Node-RED extension tab.
question_intents: How to navigate and operate the tablet application interface

children.title: TRIGGERING TASKS AND KANBANS
children.summary: This section provides step-by-step tutorials for triggering Kanbans and tasks within the tablet application. It covers the specific procedures for filtering and selecting Kanban configurations as well as initiating tasks via the Stations Choice menu.
question_intents: How to trigger Kanbans and tasks using the tablet application

children.title: QURSOR CONFIGURATION
children.summary: This section details the configuration of global system settings, including defining the plant name and managing user account access through group memberships. It also covers the setup for Single Sign-On (SSO) integration with Azure Active Directory, specifying required tenant and application IDs, server address, and HTTPS security requirements.
